messages:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — we need an agreed GA criteria for Realtime Inference (hosted). Focus: SLA, docs, support, monitoring, pricing. Can we lock numbers and owners by EOD Friday?
Maya Patel: Proposed GA checklist:
• SLA: 99.95% uptime, p99 latency < 200ms for 1-4k tokens, error rate < 0.5%
• Docs: quickstart + example apps + migration guide + FAQ
• Support: 24/7 pager for sev1, business-hours for sev2/3 with async SLAs
• Monitoring: dashboards, SLO pages, runbooks + alerting for sev1/sev2
• Pricing: tiered per-token + reserved capacity discounts + burst pricing examples
Simon Grover: Engine constraints: p99 200ms only realistic on r2-class instances with continuous batching. Small models are fine on smaller hardware. Need explicit fallback: route to lower-cost model variant or enable streaming degrade.
Olivia Martinez: Support ops: we can cover 24/7 pager if we add one more rotation engineer and finalize runbooks. Need templated KBs for: "model mismatch", "kv-cache corruption", "quota exceeded".
Maya Patel: Docs ownership proposal: @Simon infra runbooks + perf tuning, @Olivia support KBs, @Alex product copy + pricing.md, I'll own the GA checklist.
Simon Grover: SLA wording note: we can commit to 99.95% availability for the API endpoint at the project-level. Credit calculation draft: credits = min(10%, downtime_minutes / total_minutes * monthly_bill). Legal must sign off.
Alex Chen: Pricing specifics: explicit per-token generation price, per-embedding price, example invoice for 100k tokens, show reserved capacity 20% discount and burst pricing sample math. Keep language consumer-friendly.
SupportBot: Reminder: incident playbook template created -> /create-playbook realtime-ga (see internal playbooks repo).
Olivia Martinez: Also need 2 runbooks asap: "eviction & fallback" and "model rollback". I'll schedule a 60m training for support + SEs next week.
Maya Patel: Risks: launch-day scaling spikes, customers conflating p50/p99, surprise cost from burst. Mitigations: phased rollout by tier, canary ring, pre-launch customer comms and FAQ.
Simon Grover: Monitoring metrics to wire before GA: p95/p99 latency, error rate per model, request queue length, GPU utilization, kv-cache hit rate. Proposed alerting thresholds: p99 > 300ms for 5m -> page, error rate > 1% for 5m -> page, queue_length > 100 -> page.
Alex Chen: Owners & deadlines: docs (Maya) Thu EOD, infra runbooks (Simon) Thu EOD, support KBs (Olivia) Fri noon, pricing draft (Alex) Fri EOD, legal review (Samir) Fri EOD.
Samir Patel: I'll review SLA + credits. Please ping when the draft is in legal docs channel; legal needs ~48h.
Maya Patel: Locking owners. I'll create a single GA checklist doc and assign tasks in the doc. Will also add a short customer-facing FAQ snippet for pricing and SLA.
Alex Chen: Great. We'll do a quick review in Friday sync 10:00am. If anything blocks earlier @here — call it out. :thumbsup:
